dropRateInfo.title: About Drop Rate
dropRateInfo.description1: "Weight" represents the relative chance of appearing. The actual probability is calculated as the ratio of this card's weight to the total weight of all cards.
dropRateInfo.formulaText: Actual Probability = This Card's Weight ÷ Total Weight of All Cards × 100%
dropRateInfo.example1: Card A: 10%, Card B: 10%, Card C: 10%
dropRateInfo.note: * Paused cards are not included in probability calculation.

guidePage.title: Guide
guidePage.metaDescription: TwiCa usage guide. Learn how to use TwiCa as a viewer or streamer.

step1.title: Use Channel Points in Stream
step1.description: Watch a TwiCa-enabled stream and redeem the card gacha using channel points. Exchange points for the reward set by the streamer (e.g., "Card Gacha"). You can draw gacha even without logging in to TwiCa.

step2.title: Get Cards
step2.description: When you draw gacha, you'll randomly receive original cards created by the streamer. Your acquired card will also appear on stream. Even without logging in, your gacha results are automatically saved to your Twitch account.

step3.title: Login with Twitch (To View Collection)
step3.description: To view your card collection, you need to log in to TwiCa. Click the "Login with Twitch" button on the homepage to log in with your Twitch account.

step4.title: View Your Collection
step4.description: After logging in, check your acquired cards in "My Collection" on your dashboard. Statistics by rarity are also displayed.

streamer.title: For Streamers
streamer.requiresAffiliate: * Requires Twitch Affiliate or Partner status.

step1.title: Login with Twitch
step1.description: Log in to TwiCa with your Twitch account. If you're an Affiliate/Partner, streamer features are automatically enabled.

step2.title: Create Cards
step2.description: Create original cards from "Card Management" on your dashboard. Set card name, image, rarity, and drop rate.

step3.title: Set Up Channel Point Reward
step3.description: Select or create a channel point reward from "Stream Settings" on your dashboard. Click "Save & Register EventSub" to complete the Twitch integration.

step4.title: Add Overlay to OBS
step4.description: Copy the OBS browser source URL shown in "Stream Settings" and add it as a browser source in OBS. Recommended size is 800x600. Gacha results will then appear on your stream.

step5.title: Start Streaming
step5.description: Once you start streaming, viewers can draw card gacha using channel points. Acquired cards automatically appear on your stream.

tips.title: Tips
tips.tip1: Drop rates are set using "weight". The actual probability is the ratio of each card's weight to the total weight of all cards.
tips.tip2: You can temporarily exclude cards from gacha by setting them to "Paused".
tips.tip3: Uploaded images can be cropped to Square (800x800) or Portrait (800x1118). Images specified by URL are used as-is without cropping.
tips.tip4: Make sure EventSub status shows "Connected" before starting your stream.
